PROPERTY DESCRIPTION:
This remodeled spacious bi-level unit features hardwood flooring and upgraded finishes throughout.  The large open floor plan contains a living room, dining room and gas fireplace. Lighting in the open floor plan area has been changed out to energy efficient LED lighting. In the upgraded kitchen you will find granite countertops, stainless steel appliances and a breakfast bar/island.  Designer touches include high ceiling, crown moldings and recessed lighting.  The lower level bedroom and half bath make for a great Au pair possibility.  The Bedrooms have large closets.  Outdoor spaces include private decks and a shared backyard.  Garage parking for one mid-sized car available.  Laundry is non-coin operated.
The location scores a high WalkScore of 93.  Nearby services include the shops, stores and services of Laurel Heights Village.  Transit options include the Geary and California buses. Connections to Marin County are easy with Golden Gate Transit and Hwy 1 close by.
